# ExecuTorch runtime as an ESP-IDF component.
#
# GENERATED by examples/espressif/build_idf_component.sh in the
# ExecuTorch repo -- do not edit this tree by hand. Source lists live in
# et_generated.cmake next to this file; the op profile is selected with
# CONFIG_ET_OP_PROFILE_* in Kconfig (no regeneration needed to switch).

include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/et_generated.cmake)

if(NOT CONFIG_ET_ENABLE)
  # ESP-IDF links every component under components/ into the image, and
  # this component's WHOLE_ARCHIVE registration (below) is deliberately
  # GC-proof. This gate is how a project that vendors the component
  # but does not use it yet keeps its firmware unchanged (the same
  # empty-registration pattern as muse_wakeword). Consumers that use
  # the component leave CONFIG_ET_ENABLE at its default (y), or select
  # it from their own Kconfig.
  idf_component_register(INCLUDE_DIRS "include")
  return()
endif()

# Pick the Kconfig-selected profile (default: ET_DEFAULT_PROFILE).
set(_et_profile "${ET_DEFAULT_PROFILE}")
foreach(_p IN LISTS ET_PROFILES)
  string(TOUPPER "${_p}" _p_up)
  if(CONFIG_ET_OP_PROFILE_${_p_up})
    set(_et_profile "${_p}")
  endif()
endforeach()
string(TOUPPER "${_et_profile}" _ET_UP)

set(_et_srcs
    ${ET_CORE_SRCS} ${ET_PROFILE_SRCS_${_ET_UP}}
    ${ET_KERNEL_SRCS_${_ET_UP}} "src/et_model.cpp" "src/platform/esp_pal.cpp"
)

# WHOLE_ARCHIVE: kernel registration happens in static initializers in
# the profile's register_kernels.cpp; normal archive extraction would
# drop that translation unit (nothing references its symbols) and every
# operator would be missing at load time. --gc-sections still strips
# unregistered kernels and unused runtime code.
idf_component_register(
  SRCS ${_et_srcs}
  INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
  PRIV_REQUIRES esp_hw_support esp_system log heap
  WHOLE_ARCHIVE
)

target_compile_features(${COMPONENT_LIB} PUBLIC cxx_std_17)

# Consumers including <executorch/...> headers need the same c10 macro
# mode and flatbuffers alignment the runtime was built with.
target_compile_definitions(
  ${COMPONENT_LIB}
  PUBLIC C10_USING_CUSTOM_GENERATED_MACROS FLATBUFFERS_MAX_ALIGNMENT=1024
  PRIVATE MAX_KERNEL_NUM=${ET_MAX_KERNEL_NUM_${_ET_UP}}
)

if(NOT CONFIG_ET_ENABLE_LOGGING)
  target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PUBLIC ET_LOG_ENABLED=0)
endif()

# Map the Kconfig log-level floor onto esp_log_level_t for esp_pal.cpp.
if(CONFIG_ET_LOG_LEVEL_ERROR)
  set(_et_log_level 1)
elseif(CONFIG_ET_LOG_LEVEL_WARN)
  set(_et_log_level 2)
elseif(CONFIG_ET_LOG_LEVEL_DEBUG)
  set(_et_log_level 4)
else() # CONFIG_ET_LOG_LEVEL_INFO (default)
  set(_et_log_level 3)
endif()
target_compile_definitions(
  ${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE ET_ESP_LOG_LEVEL=${_et_log_level}
)

# ESP-IDF builds with warnings-as-errors; upstream ExecuTorch sources
# are not warning-clean under the IDF flag set, so demote locally.
target_compile_options(
  ${COMPONENT_LIB}
  PRIVATE -Wno-error -Wno-deprecated-declarations -Wno-unused-parameter
          -Wno-sign-compare -Wno-unused-variable
)
